capabilities: Mirror one or many Jira projects into the vault as one note per issue with YAML frontmatter
Connect to Jira Cloud or Server/Data Center via API token, PAT, or password
Sync issues on demand, on a timer, at startup, or filtered by JQL, with incremental caching
Render a filterable KPI dashboard with charts for status, productivity, bugs, and per-assignee workload
Rebuild all notes from the local cache without API calls
extras: Credentials are stored in the plugin's data.json inside the vault; the README warns to keep the vault private, notes it performs only GET requests, and points to a separate document for setup and troubleshooting. Desktop-only, no mobile support.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull Jira issue data into the vault or visualize project progress, workload, and bug counts locally.

relations.evidence: Each issue note carries frontmatter you can query with Dataview/Bases

requires.name: Jira API token or Personal Access Token (or username/password)

summary: Read-only Jira sync that mirrors issues as Markdown notes and shows a local, filterable KPI dashboard for projects, sprints, assignees, and bugs.
